description: Search for Jira users by name, username, or email address. Returns matching user accounts with display names and account IDs.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10)

query.description: Search query — matches against name, username, or email

name: atlassian-mcp__jira_search_users
